page.layout: Running head at top: "Q.VII. Constantini Magni." with page number 87 at top right. One text column below, in roman and italic type, with no margin notes. Catchword "&c." at the foot, right.

p.i: vel tranquillitatem, vel commorationem Reip. secum trahit: alia vero privatorum consistoriorum, in quibus causa & delicta privata tractatur, ad singulorum conscientias instruendas.

main_text.p: Explicavi illam Quæstionem, quantum quidem brevitas permittebat & ratio instituti postulabat. Quò inter alia facit, quod (ut cætera quæ ad illius theseos explicationem protuli omittam) dixi in hoc negotio nihil iniquè, temerè, leviter, maliciosè, à quoquam (& sic nec à Magistratu) esse faciendum, ne fraus fiat ordini à Christo institu-to, & disciplinæ Ecclesiasticæ illudatur &c.

Nec ex meathesi id quod in consideratione ponitur, sequitur magis, quàm exthe-si eadem sine ulteriore declaratione à Cl. Proff. Leyd. in Synopsi, & à cæteris Theo-logis omnibus à me ibi adductis id sequitur. Nam non est necessum, ut ob eam causam Magistratus conventibus omnibus Ecclesiasticis adsideat. Ratio est: po-test enim disciplinam Ecclesiasticam etiam absens examinare, & si quid in eâ jure desideretur, à Pastoribus exigere, ut illud ex verbi Dei analogiâ addatur vel emendetur, ut loquuntur DD. Proff de hac re verbis à me citatis, quorum ipsorum verborum allega-tio sufficere debebat ad explicationem, &c.

page.notes: The word "sufficere" and the line above it are underlined in the print. The short underline and marks at the foot of the text are not printed words. Line-end hyphens are kept as printed, so "po-test", "ex the-si" and "allega-tio" are as shown. The "Resp." line is a speaker label and is therefore a paragraph, not a heading. "meathesi" is copied as printed; the space between "mea" and "thesi" is unclear in the scan.
